rubric_items.reason: Uses only the existing route/service/repo layers, a shared helper in api/src/lib, the existing time helpers, the existing index and the API client. It adds no new infrastructure, store or endpoint.
S-1 and S-2 are mapped to components, and all of REQ-1..8 are under Known. S-2 AC2 is now checked against the list total, and the link opens on page 1. The 0 count is still a link.

Field names, types and link parameters are now given. The design does not say how the list must read the from/to bounds (half-open UTC instants or local dates), and the total-equals-count check depends on that.

The uncited fromDoctor/PATCH facts moved to U-3/Q-03, and the unknowns are tracked. The snake_case convention is stated more broadly than the cited source supports, and Q-04 still calls the window half-open.
Four trade-offs, each with a reason: the count rides on the existing GET, the dashboard rule is extracted rather than rewritten, the server returns the window bounds, and there is no cache.
Clear structure, with separate Components, Endpoints and Story coverage sections. Names are consistent between the front matter and the body.
